hints.title: Bidirectional Circular Ring Buffer
hints.text: Extend fixed-size array buffering to accommodate insertions and deletions at both front and back boundaries modulo capacity.

hints.title: Head and Tail Modular Offsets
hints.text: Maintain head index and count. Insert front moves head backward (head - 1 + k) % k. Insert last places element at (head + count) % k.

hints.title: Circular Deque Blueprint
hints.text: insertFront(v): if full return False; head = (head - 1 + k) % k, q[head] = v, count += 1, return True. insertLast(v): if full return False; q[(head + count) % k] = v, count += 1, return True. deleteFront(): head = (head + 1) % k, count -= 1. deleteLast(): count -= 1.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: K: maximum capacity of circular deque
complexity.notes: All double-ended queue operations execute in O(1) time without shifts.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Standard arrays require O(N) element relocation on front insertions and deletions.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Allocates fixed array of size K once for all operations.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Correct modular backward rotation ((head - 1 + k) % k) for front insertions.
